LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on General Etiquette. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you welcome strand, the learner should be welcome visitors at home and school to visitors at home/school?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic
2. appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GENERAL ETIQUETTE
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
General Etiquette helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: GENERAL ETIQUETTE
Study General Etiquette like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “General Etiquette” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to General Etiquette in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what General Etiquette is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “General Etiquette” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to General Etiquette in your own words. (skill: appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach General Etiquette to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The.
4. Make one local Kenya example of General Etiquette from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for General Etiquette: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study General Etiquette?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you welcome strand, the learner should be welcome visitors at home and school to visitors at home/school?
2. Which are some of the of welcome and farewell as words you can use for a sign of good behaviour good behaviour?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what General Etiquette means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate willingness  The learner be encouraged to collect litter 1. What kind of Sewa do servic.
5. Be able to: appreciate the use of videos on hospitality/community service polite words while  The.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
